goal_a_reason: Free-text greeting comparison needs semantic/paraphrase tolerance from an LLM judge, but no tool-call trajectory inspection, so the output-only judge fits.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON output with tolerance for key ordering and whitespace but deterministic (no LLM) matching is exactly what the tree-based json-similarity evaluator provides.
goal_c_reason: A binary pass-fail check for a literal substring is the dedicated purpose of the contains evaluator, no LLM needed.
